'''Ryuk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] survivor of the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. Though he survived the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] bombardment and [[Terraforming/Legends|Vongforming]] of the planet, he had the misfortune to come under the influence of [[Irek Ismaren]]. Ismaren dominated Ryuk with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and commanded him to cut through the barrier in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] containing a powerful [[Vergence/Legends|Force nexus]]. When Ryuk's cutting tool proved inadequate to the task, Ismaren killed him by throwing him violently against the wall.
